name: Poison Pawn's Gambit
author: FRO_PWR
summary: If one of your pawns is captured by a non-pawn piece, skip the enemy's turn.
description: This rare gambit skips the enemy’s turn when one of its non-pawn pieces captures one of your pawns. A hint appears when the gambit causes the skip.
